```yaml
name: Debug OCI
on:
  push:
    branches: [develop]
  pull_request:
    branches: [develop]
jobs:
  debug-oci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Setup Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: 3.1.0
          bundler-cache: true
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '18'
          cache: 'pnpm'
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pnpm install
          bundle install
      - name: Run E2E tests
        run: |
          pnpm run playwright
        env:
          CI: true
          PLAYWRIGHT_TEST_BASE_URL: http://localhost:3000
      - name: Run tryouts
        run: |
          pnpm run test:tryouts:agent
        env:
          CI: true
      - name: Run database cleaner script
        run: |
          ruby .github/scripts/clean_databases.rb --help
        env:
          RAILS_ENV: test
          REDIS_URL: redis://localhost:6379/0
          VALKEY_URL: redis://localhost:6379/0
      - name: Upload test results
        uses: codecov/test-results-action@v1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: ./test-results.xml
      - name: Upload coverage
        uses: getsentry/codecov-action@fda17cfc37e16a0cc23f61685813390bfee7daf3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          files: ./coverage/lcov.info
          flags: unittests
```
